summary: The Entropic Deep is the pressure core of the Void, where cosmic decay, collapse, and nullification converge. It is the most hostile region of the Void, where entropy becomes a metaphysical force.
history: The Deep formed when the Void collapsed inward during the first planar fracture.
Entropy condensed into metaphysical pressure wells.
The Entropy Maw emerged as a devouring sink of collapsing timelines.
The Void Heart formed as the central pressure chamber stabilizing the Void.
